description: Animate one sprite into a single 16-frame clip from a description of the motion. For several clips (walk + run + attack, or every direction) use generate_animation_set instead: it is one job. 15 credits.

end_frame.description: Optional image key for the clip to end on (e.g. to loop back to a pose). Empty = free ending

frameId.description: Optional: the frame the new frames hang under in the editor (usually the frame referenceFile came from).

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

prompt.description: The motion, e.g. 'walk cycle', 'swings sword overhead'

referenceFile.description: Work from one image of an existing frame instead of the asset's base: pass an image key exactly as get_asset lists it. Empty = the asset's current base image.

name: animate_sprite
